## Ket qua tim kiem: DAO Classes `SIM_ClassDAO`, `SIM_ScienceDAO`, `SIM_CourseDAO`

---

### Phan hien chinh: File nguon KHONG co trong workspace nay

**Cac class DAO nay duoc dinh nghia trong mot assembly ben ngoai (external DLL), khong phai la source code trong workspace `g:\0.0.0.Dashboard\cd-21`.**

Trong file project `g:\0.0.0.Dashboard\cd-21\hisa\InformationWeb.csproj` (dong 62-64) co khai bao:

```
<Reference Include="DataAccess, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, processorArchitecture=MSIL">
  <HintPath>..\..\..\Projects_2010\E Solutions\SIMS_Source 2010\bin\Debug\DataAccess.dll</HintPath>
</Reference>
```

Cac class `SIM_ClassDAO`, `SIM_ScienceDAO`, `SIM_CourseDAO` (va cac DAO khac nhu `SIM_YearDAO`, `SIM_SubjectGroupDAO`, `SIM_TeacherDAO`, `SIM_ScheduleDAO`, `SIM_RoomDAO`, `SIM_AreaDAO`, `SIM_Class_SubjectDAO`, `SIM_SummaryPlanDAO`, `SIM_WeekDetailPlanDAO`) deu thuoc `namespace DataAccess` trong DLL do.

### DAO Pattern duoc tai tao tu usage analysis

Tu tat ca cac usage sites trong codebase, co the tai tao duoc pattern cua cac DAO class nhu sau:

#### 1. Constructor

```csharp
// Cach 1: Parameterless constructor (pho bien nhat)
new SIM_ClassDAO()

// Cach 2: Constructor nhan IData (Core.IDB) de su dung ket noi DB hien co
new SIM_ClassDAO(objIData)
```

#### 2. Phuong thuc `Search(...)` — tra ve DataTable

Day la phuong thuc chinh cua moi DAO. Nhan so luong tham so bien doi (variadic) theo cap `key, value`:

```csharp
// Khong tham so
DataTable dtbScience = new SIM_ScienceDAO().Search();

// 1 cap tham so
DataTable dtbCourse = new SIM_CourseDAO().Search("@IsActived", 1);

// 2 cap tham so
DataTable dtbClass = new SIM_ClassDAO().Search("@ClassType", 0, "@IsActived", 1);

// Nhieu cap tham so (named parameters style)
DataTable dtbClassList = new SIM_ClassDAO().Search(
    "@YearID", intYearID,
    "@ScienceID", scienceID,
    "@CourseID", courseID,
    "@ClassID", classID,
    "@IsActived", 1,
    "ClassTypeList", ",0,3,");
```

Pattern tham so: Moi cap la `"@ParamName", value`. Cac tham so co tien to `@` mapping vao stored procedure parameters.

#### 3. Cac phuong thuc entity-specific

```csharp
// SIM_ClassDAO: Tim lop to/nho lien quan cho auto scheduling
new SIM_ClassDAO().SearchBigAndSmallForAutoScheduling("@YearID", uYearSemester1.YearID);

// SIM_ClassDAO: Lay ClassID tham chieu
new SIM_ClassDAO().GetReferenceClassID(objReferenceClassID);

// SIM_YearDAO: Lay mot Year entity (tra ve SIM_Year object)
SIM_Year itemYear = new SIM_YearDAO().Get(intYearID);
// Su dung: itemYear.StartAt (DateTime property)

// SIM_Class_SubjectDAO: Lay trang thai lop-mon
new SIM_Class_SubjectDAO().GetStatusForClass("@YearID", yearID, ...);

// SIM_Class_SubjectDAO: Lay mon chua duoc xep lich
new SIM_Class_SubjectDAO().GetNotSchedule("@ClassID", classID, ...);

// SIM_ScheduleDAO: Tim lich cho lop
new SIM_ScheduleDAO().SearchForClass("@YearID", intYearID, ...);

// SIM_WeekDetailPlanDAO: Lay danh sach tuan
new SIM_WeekDetailPlanDAO().GetListWeek(intYearID, intSemester, null);
```

#### 4. BO Constant classes (cung nam trong external assembly)

Cac BO class dinh nghia hang so ten cot (column name constants), su dung chung voi DAO:

```csharp
// Trong BO namespace (external assembly)
SIM_Class.C_CLASSID      // "ClassID"
SIM_Class.C_CLASSNAME    // "ClassName"
SIM_Class.C_CLASSTYPE    // "ClassType"
SIM_Science.C_SCIENCEID   // "ScienceID"
SIM_Science.C_SCIENCENAME // "ScienceName"
SIM_Course.C_COURSEID     // "CourseID"
SIM_Course.C_COURSENAME   // "CourseName"
```

Su dung dien hinh:

```98:103:g:\0.0.0.Dashboard\cd-21\hisa\Controls\Sims\UClass.ascx.cs
            DataTable dtbScience = new SIM_ScienceDAO().Search();
            WebGlobal.InitDropDownList(ddlScienceID, dtbScience, SIM_Science.C_SCIENCEID, SIM_Science.C_SCIENCENAME, "--Chọn--");

            DataTable dtbCourse = new SIM_CourseDAO().Search("IsActived", 1);
            WebGlobal.InitDropDownList(ddlCourseID, dtbCourse, SIM_Course.C_COURSEID, SIM_Course.C_COURSENAME, "--Chọn--");
```

---

### Ve kien truc tong the

Theo tai lieu `docs-dashboard.html` (dong 183-248), he thong su dung 3 tang data access:

| Loai | Namespace | Vi du | Pattern |
|------|-----------|-------|---------|
| **DAO thuan** | `DataAccess` | `SIM_ClassDAO`, `SIM_ScienceDAO`, `SIM_CourseDAO`, `SIM_YearDAO` | `Search()` tra ve `DataTable` |
| **Business Object** | `SimsObject` | `SIM_Class`, `SIM_Student`, `SIM_Branch` | `GetDataTable(spName, params...)` |
| **BO Constants** | `BO` | `SIM_Class`, `SIM_Science`, `SIM_Course` | Hang so ten cot |

---

### Tom tat

- **File nguon cua `SIM_ClassDAO`, `SIM_ScienceDAO`, `SIM_CourseDAO` KHONG co trong workspace nay.** Chung nam trong `DataAccess.dll` mot project ben ngoai khong duoc bao gom trong `g:\0.0.0.Dashboard\cd-21`.
- Pattern DAO: parameterless constructor (hoac constructor nhan `IData`), phuong thuc `Search(@param, value, ...)` tra ve `DataTable`, cac phuong thuc entity-specific (nhu `SearchBigAndSmallForAutoScheduling`, `GetReferenceClassID`, `Get`).
- Neu can xem source code DAO, can truy cap project `SIMS_Source 2010` nam ngoai workspace nay.
